limits: The PR bot is not installed and its criterion is not met. It moved to SEEN-102 as a human decision, with the read-access and public-page questions written down. Nothing in this ticket depends on it.

The repowise MCP tools were exercised by driving the server over stdio from a script, not from inside a Claude Code or Codex session, because the server list is loaded when a session starts and this one was already running. The committed .mcp.json entry was verified to start a server that lists all ten tools.
Codex was wired by repowise agents add, which wrote fourteen prompt files under ~/.codex/prompts and a distill rewrite hook. No Codex session has used any of it.

repowise is installed under Python 3.12 because watchdog 4.0.2 has no wheel for 3.14 and building it needs an Xcode licence this machine has not accepted. On a machine with only 3.14 the harness keeps working and records the absence, which is tested, but nobody has run it on such a machine.
The change-risk answer went into one real decision. Whether it improves the risk judgement across many tickets is unmeasured, and SEEN-091's reports are where that would show.
The review was a self-review, like every ticket in this epic. An independent pass over the harness is still owed.
